g.text: eval only – no term in the loss
module: committee( b ) = every finished seed EXCEPT b – M = min ( n − 1 , 5 )
rounds 5–6 – two hyperparameters, and between them they measured one thing
vote { 2 , 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 } × { borda , median , cvar1 , cvar2 , max }
what the audit found in the recorded runs
the seed sets the BLOCK, not the models – ten so-called seeds were TWO committees
and the five rules are order statistics of ONE rank matrix – they correlate r = 0.87 – 0.98
leave-one-out – the committee is chosen by the data
for episode block b the members are every finished seed EXCEPT b, so M = n − 1 is not chosen at all
filled = eligible for this block's committee · crossed = the one seed left out, a different one every block
the committee is the first M of the filled slots, in order · M is the capped value below, not the 15 drawn
M is CAPPED – first by the smaller arm, then by memory
an unmatched M would confound committee size with the feature – the same error as the unmatched latent dimension
16 cls committees and 12 patch committees, every one of them at M = 5
members stack on the PATCH axis: a patch member costs 256 slots where a cls member costs 1, so M = 11 patch OOMs and M = 5 fits
M = min ( n − 1 over both arms , 5 ) , the 5 from memory
score( c ) = medianm rankm( c ) , the rank within the CEM batch
median-of-ranks is scale-free, so members need not share a latent basis, and it is defined at every M
nothing here enters a training loss
